test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**interactions**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Blank no. 4** is referring to the **various physical and chemical processes that lead to the formation of soil**.
 
• The correct option would be "**interactions**" as it indicates the **different ways in which weathered particles of rocks and organic components interact with each other to form soil**.
 
• The other options, such as "**compositions**" and "**connections**," are not as appropriate as they **do not capture the complexity of the processes involved in soil formation**.

Thus, ***option 3*** is the correct answer.

Correct paragraph__: *The soft layer of the earth's (1) surface on which plants grow is referred to as soil. Soil includes a huge amount of both organic and inorganic (2) components. In the soil, the organic components known as humus are formed from (3) decomposed plant and animal remnants. These are combined with weathered particles of various rocks to form soil. Weathering occurs as a result of different chemical and physical (4) interactions that occur on the earth's surface. Soil formation is a (5) gradual process in general. For example, the creation of a 2.5 cm thick soil layer might take more than 1000 years.*
